notes.title: Mark Hamill To Host ‘Thunderful World’ Digital Showcase on November 10th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569367/892bc383a39eb0b46c5b4b09af85c4f9f1be9298.jpg[/img]

Hey friends,

we have some awesome news, which we can finally share with you today: We - that's Thunderful Games - welcome all of you to the premiere of our very first digital games showcase ‘[b]Thunderful World[/b]’! ːsteamhappyː

Find out more in the following press release:


[i][b]Gothenburg, Sweden - October 28th, 2021[/b] - International developer and publisher Thunderful Games, creator of the multi-award winning and multi-million selling SteamWorld franchise, is welcoming everyone to a new digital games showcase, ‘[b]Thunderful World[/b]’. The event will be taking place on [b]November 10th at 11am PT / 2pm ET / 7pm GMT / 8pm CET[/b], hosted by Hollywood and pop culture icon [b]Mark Hamill[/b]. Tune in to the livestream on Twitch, YouTube and the [url=https://thunderful.world/][b]thunderful.world[/b][/url] website.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569367/8a01bc9ec10d1ba6e674354314fd34accd1fbb51.png[/img]

Tune in to see Mark delight us with a ton of exciting new game reveals and announcements from Thunderful. The event will deliver updates on exciting upcoming titles including the surprise indie hit of Summer Game Fest, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608230/Planet_of_Lana/][b]Planet of Lana[/b][/url]. There will also be more news on Thunderful titles like [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608550/Firegirl_Hack_n_Splash_Rescue/][b]Firegirl[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1726120/Cursed_to_Golf/][b]Cursed to Golf[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1315610/Source_of_Madness/][b]Source of Madness[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1276660/Tinkertown/][b]Tinkertown[/b][/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158890/White_Shadows/][b]White Shadows[/b][/url]. 

Alongside Mark’s headline hosting role, the event will also feature appearances from Thunderful Group CEO Brjánn Sigurgeirsson, Corporate Vice President at Xbox Sarah Bond, plus a few other surprise industry partners.

Thunderful is proud to be partnering with Xbox and The MIX for Thunderful World. To sign up for the event and be the first to know all the important information ahead of the show on [b]November 10th[/b], head over to [url=https://thunderful.world/][b]thunderful.world[/b][/url]. As your one stop shop for all things Thunderful World, the website will be updated with new announcements and reveals as the event unfolds.[/i]


Stay tuned and tune in on Nov 10th - see you all in the event!
Your Thunderful Games-Team

notes.title: Welcome to the hellish depths: Escape from Naraka is out now! Do you dare?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38810689/bf350ab54a2ed414f899b966b9bcb5a926732629.jpg[/img]

Greetings, escapees!

First things first: [b]ESCAPE FROM NARAKA[/b] IS OUT NOW! ːsteamhappyː Here is the release trailer to prove it:

[previewyoutube=vcxvuUpL_fQ;full][https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vcxvuUpL_fQ][/previewyoutube]
We really can't be more happy about this! [b]Escape from Naraka[/b] is our very first release as an independent indie studio and this really feels awesome! Like in all the rest of the world, the last few months have not been easy for us as well, so we are all the more proud that everything finally worked out.

Developing a game means many months with a bunch of ups and downs; any developer will tell you that. But the feeling of happiness at the release is worth it all! We hope you have as much fun playing [b]Escape from Naraka[/b] as we had developing the game.

For us, as this tiny 3 dev team that we are, it was and still is a great honor to collaborate with Nvidia to bring RTX and DLSS to life in the game. This makes us the very first Indonesian developer that shipped a game with Ray Tracing. Unbelievable...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38810689/1db7997a3adce6c41ef63bea9ed7876f6f3ec42e.jpg[/img]

But enough emotional words now. We thank you all very much for sharing this experience with us. Please leave your feedback and your thoughts in the Steam community or share them on our Discord. We are really looking forward to meet you there.

And now have fun escaping the hellish depth of Naraka!
Fathur, Yosua & Irfan - The Xelo Games Team

notes.title: Escape from Naraka supports DLSS and Ray-Tracing for release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38810689/c92e68a62356c1675b94cdec1e45be4c151b3a24.jpg[/img]

Greetings, escapees!

Even if we are just a small three dev indie team, we want to make our game shine as good as possible. This is one of the reasons why we decided to develop [b]Escape from Naraka[/b] on Epic's Unreal Engine 4. It is a very powerful tool!

This is also the reason why our ways crossed with [b]Nvidia[/b]. When they offered us the opportunity to work with them on implementing Ray-Tracing and DLSS to [b]Escape from Naraka[/b], we didn't have to think twice before saying "Yes!". Because for us as a small three-person development team, it's a great honor to work with [b]Nvidia[/b]. Like a dream come true!

Of course, we asked ourselves beforehand whether [b]Escape from Naraka[/b] could benefit from DLSS and Ray-Tracing. And since it's a mix of runner and platformer including Steam Leaderboards, and it is up to the player to achieve the best possible time, the extra FPS won't hurt. DLSS? Check!

[previewyoutube=Ft7ngeRoW6I;full][RTX_VIDEO][/previewyoutube]
Although players run and jump through hell and the game is interpreted in a very mythological way, the presentation and style is realistic. We photographed many elements such as statues or entire temple areas by hand and implemented them into the game. And to emphasize that, we've included several RTX technologies into [b]Escape from Naraka[/b]. Ray-Tracing? Check! But of course, even without Ray-Tracing and DLSS, the game looks as good as we could make it!

We make use of Ray-Traced Reflections, Ray-Traced Shadows and Hybrid Translucency. So where and how will you notice Ray-Tracing in [b]Escape from Naraka[/b]? There are real-time reflections on water and smooth surfaces and softer and more realistic shadows. Overall, our hell makes a much more realistic impression this way. If you can put it that way. ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38810689/37a87eff0e32e25e14d96b3707ca6a1edc30adac.png[/img]

But the cherry on top is RTX Global Illumination! Using it the light is bouncing with very high accuracy and supports the more realistic impression even more. Thus, the warm torchlight is reflected on smooth surfaces of figures or refracts realistically on the uneven stones of walls. Really impressive! Overall RTX Global Illumination makes the levels much more homogeneous.

It was a really exciting ride for us to implement Ray-Tracing to our game! Of course, it is always a matter of taste, but we LOVE how [b]Escape from Naraka[/b] is looking with Ray-Tracing and DLSS on! And that's why we thank [b]Nvidia[/b] for their support. Without you, [b]Escape from Naraka[/b] wouldn't look as good as it is doing for its release on July 29th! So: "[u][b]Thank you![/b][/u]"

And to all of you escapees out there: See you in the hellish depth of Naraka next week!
The Xelo Games Team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1390670/Escape_from_Naraka/

notes.title: February Dev Update!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38810689/a1f333edab84f771368dc8f3d684d66eae32dec8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38810689/9ceed78d33091a144bdcd7e921099fd8a46cfac6.png[/img][/url][b]
Hi! Escapers! This is what we are working in last month to improving Escape from Naraka![/b]
[olist]
[*]Lighting Improvements
[*]Add key mapping options
[*]Add audio volumes options
[*]Add invert mouse option
[*]Default button for dash is now right mouse button (prev: F)
[*]Default button for interact is now E (prev: left mouse button)
[*]"Load Checkpoint" button is now auto focused in the death screen so that the player can simply press 'SPACE' or 'ENTER' to automatically load the last checkpoint
[*]Add stage timer in HUD, it is by default turned off and can be turned on in the options menu
[*]Add artifact counter in HUD that is shown only when players get an artifact (similar to how the coin counter is shown)
[*]Sync hand movement to footstep sound
[*]Crouch footstep sound is now significantly more frequent
[/olist]
Stay tuned for more [b]Info[/b] and [b]Update[/b]!
